concept_dictionary.binding_rule: The final operator must halt if the loaded dictionary hash or required concept structure differs. This specification imports the exact current terms from that file; it does not add source-specific terms, synonyms, wildcards, or controlled-vocabulary mappings.

source_boundary.intended_boundary: The full public ESA Indico event, contribution/subcontribution, event-material, contribution-material, and direct-public-PDF population visible at the final snapshot time.

current_observations.claim: A public root-category export for category 0 returned eight rows and count=8 for the bounded 2023-11-01 through 2023-11-30 input; two passes had the same ordered event IDs and response hash.

Historical P01 event exports with detail=contributions supplied event ID, contribution db_id values, nested material folders, and some attachment URLs for a bounded event, but omitted two attachment IDs subsequently found on contribution page and rendered timetable routes. P01's historical route is retained as evidence only, not as the prospective method.
The public static event root can expose an event-level attachment, and a bounded event export contained both PDF and non-PDF materials.
A bounded corrected-detail event export exposed an event-owned legacy material.resources object whose resource URL was safely recognized as a same-origin attachment route.
The two P01 static-only event-472 links were access-unverified in P01; separate P02 anonymous no-redirect GETs classified both access_restricted_or_login.

In a repeated November 2023 window, category 0 returned the exact union of explicit category-5 and category-6 windows (8 IDs total). This proves only the stated bounded root/component observation, not all-descendant recursion.
A 2020-2024 category-0 cap probe returned count=148 and 148 rows in two identical ordered/hash passes. The response complete flag was absent/null, so no general no-cap claim is made.

unproven_assumptions_that_must_not_be_us: That category 0 recursively and exhaustively includes every public ESA category for all time.
That the category export's from/to semantics can enumerate every historic/current public event without a validated start/end sentinel or a hidden response cap.
That the public export includes every subcontribution or gives its rendered route.
That static owner pages remain a complete material listing for every future event type.

route_plan.head_requests: not_used; the bounded pilot observed HTTP 400 on HEAD while equivalent direct GET routes succeeded.

rate_limit.failure_rule: A no-redirect 3xx/login handoff, access, challenge, transport, parse, or rate-limit exhaustion is a failed route/coverage condition, never a source zero. Close error responses and do not retain response headers, cookies, redirect targets/queries, or session identifiers.

event_census.purpose: Enumerate source event IDs, not candidates.
required_invariants_per_window: response count is a non-negative integer and exactly equals results.length
every event ID is non-empty and unique within the response
each public event URL path exactly agrees with its event ID
no result row is malformed or silently dropped
event_census.full_run_design: P03 observed inclusive event-period overlap: event 472 appeared on its 2023-11-16 start/end day but not 2023-11-17, event 467 appeared on both 2023-11-16 and 2023-11-17, and long-running events remained on 2023-11-18. It also observed accepted bounded zero inputs at 1900-01-01 and 2100-01-01. Before final execution, the supervisor must freeze defensible lower/upper sentinels, calibrate parent-window versus overlapping child-window unions for a cap check, partition the validated interval with one-day overlap, preserve every occurrence, and reconcile the stable event-ID union in two passes. A count==rows result and an absent/null complete flag are necessary but not all-time completeness proof.

required_invariants: response count equals 1 and results.length equals 1
returned event ID equals the requested event ID
every contribution has a stable db_id/contribution_id/id and a matching canonical contribution path
read case-sensitive subContributions; use lowercase subcontributions only when the documented field is absent, and fail on conflicting dual fields
recognize legacy material[].resources[] resource IDs/names/same-origin URLs without losing event/contribution owner identity
conflicting duplicate contribution IDs fail coverage
event and contribution metadata are retained/hashed separately from attachment/PDF documents
for a sessions-bearing representative event, require the detail=subcontributions contribution-ID set to equal the detail=sessions top-level-plus-session contribution-ID union; fail on a mismatch
event_and_contribution_metadata.historical_p01_limit: P01 actually used detail=contributions. It remains historical evidence and must not be described as a detail=subcontributions execution.
event_and_contribution_metadata.observed_limit: This route is not treated as a complete material enumeration route because attachment IDs 9769 and 9770 were absent from the bounded historical P01 event export but present on a contribution page/timetable route. P03 observed for event 407 that detail=subcontributions listed 62 contribution IDs and exactly matched the union exposed by detail=sessions (11 top-level plus 51 session-held IDs); this validates that route only for the sampled session-bearing event.

event_material_enumeration.method: Fetch the public static HTML with GET and extract only direct attachment paths matching the prospectively pinned event attachment pattern.
event_material_enumeration.observed: Event 407's static root page contained one observed event-level attachment path.

contribution_material_enumeration.method: Fetch every exported contribution's public static HTML with GET and extract only direct attachment paths matching the prospectively pinned contribution attachment pattern.
contribution_material_enumeration.reconciliation: Preserve true export_attachment_ids before static merging and separately record all_route_attachment_ids. The union of export-declared-unprotected validated-direct attachments must be a subset of static owner-page attachments. Static-only IDs are retained rather than discarded and start access_unverified; a direct access result, ID/owner/path conflict, or conflicting attachment metadata is explicit. An export-declared-unprotected item whose anonymous GET is restricted is a coverage failure; a static-only/unknown-protection item whose no-redirect GET is restricted is a terminal non-public boundary disposition, not a public PDF or zero.
contribution_material_enumeration.observed: Two static-only attachment IDs were reproducible across two event-472 passes; P01 did not GET them and P02 later classified both access_restricted_or_login.

subcontribution_handling.enumeration: Request detail=subcontributions, record every documented subContributions record as the composite event_id:parent_contribution_id:subcontribution_id, and preserve its own metadata route. Lowercase subcontributions is only a compatibility fallback if the documented field is absent.
subcontribution_handling.material_route: unvalidated; P03 found no non-empty subContributions record in 19 successful bounded event exports (and one separate export failed on an attachment metadata identity conflict), so it did not fabricate a nested material route.
subcontribution_handling.fallback: Generate a content-free manual/browser navigation queue with stable IDs, terminal outcome, timestamp, operator, and coverage-receipt checksum. No validated receipt means incomplete coverage; no final event may proceed when a non-empty nested record appears until its owner/material route is proven.

direct_pdf_full_text.route_source: Only a same-origin direct attachment whose separate anonymous no-redirect GET proves application/pdf plus %PDF- is a confirmed public PDF. An export is_protected=false value and a visible .pdf filename/path are provisional until that GET succeeds. A static-only/unknown-protection 3xx/login disposition is non-public; an export-declared-unprotected 3xx/login result is a coverage conflict.
direct_pdf_full_text.secure_storage: PDF bytes and extracted text must be outside every Git worktree. The Git ledger stores only IDs, route paths, hashes, byte counts, parser/OCR state, and a logical secure-location reference.
direct_pdf_full_text.deterministic_parser: pdftotext UTF-8. A non-zero parser exit is a parse failure. Empty deterministic text is OCR-required, not zero text/no match. OCR text is accepted only after an external, content-safe receipt keyed to the OCR queue ID/PDF checksum and matching the stripped OCR-body hash/byte count.
direct_pdf_full_text.observed: P03 completed one bounded event-472 public-PDF route: all 13 confirmed public PDFs were separately anonymously GET-probed, fetched, checksummed, and parsed; 11 had deterministic text and two empty parses completed the mandated outside-Git OCR handoff. The two static-only links were separately classified restricted/non-public. Matching ran only after that bounded material/PDF/OCR coverage reconciled, with no candidate import.

rendered_route_cross_check.role: A reproducible adapter-owned-browser/manual check for visible attachment IDs when static/export routes disagree or an event type is irregular. It is not a substitute for deterministic event/contribution traversal.
rendered_route_cross_check.receipt_contract: esa-indico-manual-navigation-receipt/v1 with stable input IDs, outcome, timestamp, operator, and observed attachment IDs/paths; no source text or browser-tab URL.
rendered_route_cross_check.observed: A queued rendered timetable receipt reconciled all fifteen event-472 attachment IDs, including two absent from export. It did not prove those links public; P01 access was unverified and P02 later classified both restricted/login.
rendered_route_cross_check.browser_anchor_correction: P01 controller-anchor continuity is unproved after the owned-tab closure; controller restoration is observed. No browser URL is retained.

stable_identity_and_duplicate_rules.contribution: event_id:contribution_stable_id (db_id preferred, then contribution_id or id)
stable_identity_and_duplicate_rules.attachment: attachment_id plus owner and canonical direct route path; a conflicting URL, owner, content metadata, or hash for one stable attachment ID fails the event
stable_identity_and_duplicate_rules.document_route: event/contribution/subcontribution/attachment object identity plus route_type; no route ID may repeat
stable_identity_and_duplicate_rules.duplicate_discovery: Keep every raw discovery occurrence/window/pass in the ledger. Collapse only identical stable identities after all pass-level reconciliation. Never erase a source row just because a later route names the same object.
stable_identity_and_duplicate_rules.changed_or_disappearing_content: If an item appears in pass A but not pass B, a route hash/ID changes, a listed public attachment vanishes, or a direct PDF hash changes, mark the event/window failed and restart from an explicitly documented new snapshot; do not merge a prefix.

local_document_routes_and_field_boundari.rule: Required concepts may combine only within exactly one local document route. They never combine across event, contribution, subcontribution, attachment, PDF, non-PDF text route, different records, or independently fetched pages.

fields: keywords (each list value is a separate field boundary)
routes.combination_rule: Independent concept tests may co-occur only for diagnostic audit within this metadata document. An ordered phrase cannot cross a field boundary or two separate keyword-list values. This route is candidate_eligible=false: metadata is not sufficient for ESA discovery.

fields: keywords (each list value is a separate field boundary)
routes.combination_rule: Same-object diagnostic metadata only; never combines parent event metadata or an attachment. Ordered phrases cannot cross separate keyword-list values. This route is candidate_eligible=false.

fields: keywords (each list value is a separate field boundary)
routes.combination_rule: Same-object diagnostic metadata only. Ordered phrases cannot cross separate keyword-list values. This route is candidate_eligible=false and blocked from final use until nested coverage is validated.

routes.source_object: one attachment_id with its event or contribution owner
routes.combination_rule: Same attachment only; a filename does not borrow terms from its parent record. This route is candidate_eligible=false: attachment metadata/filenames are not sufficient for ESA discovery.

routes.source_object: one public attachment_id and one exact PDF hash
routes.combination_rule: A confirmed public PDF is its own required candidate_eligible=true local document route. It never combines with its filename, attachment metadata, contribution metadata, event metadata, or another PDF. OCR body frontmatter is stripped before matching.

routes.source_object: one public non-PDF attachment_id and its terminal extractor/manual text hash
routes.combination_rule: A non-PDF text route is its own attachment document and is required for coverage accounting, but is candidate_eligible=false under the ESA PDF-content constraint unless a future protocol-approved route reclassifies it as a confirmed PDF. It is created only after a supported deterministic extractor or replayable manual/LLM text-route receipt; no source text is retained in Git. An inaccessible, unsupported, or unparseable item leaves coverage null rather than becoming a no-match.

local_document_routes_and_field_boundari.status: P03-implemented: metadata/filenames are auditable noncandidate routes; only terminal confirmed public PDF text or OCR text is candidate_eligible. Reviewer confirmation of exact local normalization remains required.

normalization_and_matching.whitespace: HTML entities are decoded, markup is stripped from source metadata, and whitespace is collapsed for matching. Distinct values in a source keywords list remain distinct local fields, so an ordered phrase cannot cross their boundary.
normalization_and_matching.lexical_tokens: Unicode word tokens excluding underscore. Token matching supplies standalone acronym boundaries; a token MBSE cannot match xMBSE or MBSE2023.
normalization_and_matching.ordered_phrases: Every finite multiword dictionary entry is tokenized under the same policy and must occur contiguously in the listed order within one field. No phrase crosses a field boundary.
normalization_and_matching.punctuation_and_hyphens: The Unicode hyphen family is normalized to ASCII hyphen; hyphens and ordinary punctuation delimit tokens. This intentionally treats the dictionary's explicitly listed hyphenated and spaced spellings as equivalent local lexical sequences. Period-separated or otherwise unlisted acronym spellings are not compacted.
normalization_and_matching.wildcards_stemming_expansion: None. The matcher uses only literal dictionary terms, including each listed singular/plural and spelling form. nanosat* is never substituted.

pair_rule.formula: For non-overlapping left/right spans in one field, count tokens strictly between the end of the earlier span and start of the later span; accept only <=5.

normalization_and_matching.R_architecture_exclusion: An R hit exactly equal to architecture/architectures is suppressed only when its span is consumed by a G_model, G_structure, C1, or T2 artifact expression in the same field. A separate architecture span can still be independent R.
normalization_and_matching.basis: draft_local_implementation; its unit tests are evidence for code behavior, not proof of ESA native search behavior

concept_implementation.P: Exact finite-term matcher for dictionary concept P.
concept_implementation.E_H: Exact finite-term matcher for dictionary E_H.
concept_implementation.E_F: Exact finite-term matcher for dictionary E_F.
concept_implementation.E: E_H OR E_F within the same document route.
concept_implementation.M_H: Exact finite-term matcher for dictionary M_H.
concept_implementation.M_B: Exact finite-term matcher for dictionary M_B.
concept_implementation.M: M_H OR M_B within the same document route.
concept_implementation.G_model: Exact direct terms plus each dictionary pair rule using the maximum-five-token rule.
concept_implementation.G_structure: Exact direct terms plus each dictionary pair rule using the maximum-five-token rule.
concept_implementation.C1: Exact direct terms plus each dictionary pair rule using the maximum-five-token rule; bare library, pattern, profile, or language is not a match because it is not in C1.
concept_implementation.R: Exact finite-term matcher, after the independent-architecture suppression rule.
concept_implementation.T2: Exact dictionary left/right pairing with unordered maximum-five-token rule.

independent_tags_per_document_route.B2_equivalent_tag: P AND M_B AND independent R

candidate_partitions_tags_and_accounting.candidate_union: For a candidate_eligible terminal public-PDF/PDF-OCR route only, core_B OR BG1 OR BG2 OR BC1. Metadata, contribution, event, attachment filename, and non-PDF routes may retain diagnostic raw matches/tags but cannot emit an ESA candidate. Neither a tag nor a candidate establishes scientific eligibility.
invariants: on candidate_eligible routes, candidate_union equals the OR of the four candidate partitions; noncandidate metadata/filename routes expose only raw diagnostic matches
each document route ID is unique
all output hits include term/pair spans and field labels but no retained source snippet
route-level and source-object-level counts remain separate
candidate_partitions_tags_and_accounting.overlap_accounting: Record raw diagnostic route matches separately from candidate-eligible terminal-PDF route counts; report per-partition candidate document-route counts, every pairwise candidate intersection, candidate document-route union, and candidate source-object union. Preserve all route IDs behind a source object so later deduplication cannot erase route provenance.
candidate_partitions_tags_and_accounting.screening_prohibition: This local matching is discovery only. It must not code eligibility, population validity, EPS-route validity, language, date, publication type, or an included report.

search_box_and_controlled_vocabulary.reason: The human-supervisor method constraint requires local harvest. In current event-only probes, MBSE returned four events but MBSE AND CubeSat and MBSE OR CubeSat each returned an explicit zero; no fielded Boolean syntax or complete Boolean implementation was validated. A zero on those diagnostic strings is not treated as a final source zero.
search_box_and_controlled_vocabulary.phrase_observation: Quoted and unquoted MBSE, and quoted/unquoted model based systems engineering, returned the same bounded event IDs/hash in observed probes. This does not prove general exact-phrase semantics.
search_box_and_controlled_vocabulary.punctuation_observation: model-based systems engineering returned zero in the bounded event probe whereas model based systems engineering returned four IDs; no punctuation normalization is accepted for native search.
search_box_and_controlled_vocabulary.acronym_and_token_observation: MBSE and MBSE2023 returned observed event rows, but event keywords could explain the result, so standalone native acronym boundary behavior remains unvalidated.
search_box_and_controlled_vocabulary.stemming_expansion_observation: First pages for nanosatellite, nanosatellites, and nanosat differed and had unavailable total=-1 with next pages; stemming/expansion is not assumed.
search_box_and_controlled_vocabulary.implicit_term_behavior: Only q plus result type parameters were observed in the public route. No source-side implicit conjunction, field selection, proximity, or block nesting is accepted.

controlled_vocabulary.assessment: No genuine controlled vocabulary or distinct indexed-term field was validated. The bounded export exposed generic keywords only; no descriptor, scope-note, hierarchy, thesaurus, or explosion control was observed. Keywords are not emulated as controlled vocabulary.

date_language_and_limits.common_evidence_cutoff: TBD under P-001; no final run may start while it remains unset.
date_language_and_limits.date_behavior: Event start/end date and attachment modified date are retained only as source metadata. They are not assumed to be formal publication dates and do not exclude a local document route. Formal date eligibility is determined later during screening/retrieval.
date_language_and_limits.language_behavior: Event language metadata may be retained, but no native English filter is applied and metadata cannot establish full-report language. Language remains a screening/retrieval decision.
date_language_and_limits.discovery_limits: No publication type, access, peer-review, venue, content-type, or subject limit is applied. Every public non-PDF item receives either a supported deterministic text extractor or a replayable human/LLM/manual text-route queue even though it cannot itself emit a PDF-only ESA candidate. Static-only links remain access_unverified until GET proves public access; irregular/external links are ledgered and queued. None of these states is a zero or silent deletion.
date_language_and_limits.source_date_window_design_status: P03 observed date-span overlap and accepted zero inputs at 1900-01-01 and 2100-01-01, but those are candidate sentinels only. The final calendar partition and all-time root coverage remain blocked pending a supervisor-approved all-public boundary/cap calibration; source event dates are never a lossless publication-date filter.

pass_A: Create a timestamped source snapshot and calendar-window plan only after the root-category boundary gate passes.
Enumerate/reconcile every root-category window and preserve every raw occurrence.
Fetch/reconcile every event export, static event page, and every static contribution page.

Generate/check the material ledger, probe static-only access, download/hash every confirmed public PDF, extract PDF/non-PDF text or complete OCR/manual receipts, and match only when all coverage states pass.
pass_B: Repeat all pass-A routes from a fresh anonymous client in the same declared snapshot window and source order.

Require equality of per-window count/ordered event IDs, event/contribution/subcontribution IDs, true export and all-route attachment owner/ID/path ledgers, public PDF checksum ledger, PDF/non-PDF parser/manual terminal states, and deterministic matching output.
Use rendered/manual queue receipts as a third route only for declared irregular items; validate queue IDs one-to-one and require expected attachment IDs as a subset of observed IDs.
completeness_and_two_pass_design.success_gate: Only a complete A/B equality reconciliation and resolved required manual/OCR queue can create a final local-harvest result. If a source changes during the run, report total=null and do not import a partial prefix.
completeness_and_two_pass_design.pilot_result: P01's historical identifier/topology facts and P02's correction remain preserved. P03 additionally completed one current event-472 public-PDF/OCR/matching path (13 confirmed public PDFs, two restricted static-only links excluded as non-public), compared current sessions/subcontributions contribution inventories for event 407, and fully owner-page/probe enumerated event 407's 28 public non-PDF routes into a failure-closed queue. It also observed an event-321 attachment title identity conflict. These are method diagnostics, not a final census, screening, candidate import, or two-download-pass proof.

failure_and_zero_rules.valid_explicit_zero: Only a complete, reconciled source response whose native count is exactly 0 for the declared bounded operation. Search-box diagnostic zeros cannot represent the local harvest source zero.
mandatory_null_or_failed_coverage: category count/row mismatch, duplicate/conflicting/missing ID, hidden cap, changed ordered pass, or missing boundary proof
static owner page inaccessible, malformed, or missing an export-declared-unprotected attachment
attachment owner/URL/metadata conflict (including P03's event-321 title conflict) or disappearing content
protected/restricted direct file without an explicit public-boundary disposition

a static-only/unknown-protection link called public without a no-redirect GET; an export-declared-unprotected link whose no-redirect GET is restricted; wrong content type, redirect, invalid magic header, checksum conflict, parser error, empty text without completed OCR, or unresolved manual receipt
public non-PDF without a completed deterministic extractor or replayable manual/LLM text-route receipt; irregular/external material silently dropped instead of queued
any unmatched queue item, access challenge, authentication prompt, CAPTCHA, or transport failure
failure_and_zero_rules.partial_prefix_rule: Do not issue candidate records, source totals, or final-event import from a prefix. Preserve only quarantined safe ledgers/receipts and a failure reason.
failure_and_zero_rules.unusable_route_observation: Two candidate contribution-export routes returned 404 and 503 in the pilot and are explicitly not used; a failed route is not a zero.

deterministic_scope: anonymous public GET, no redirects, rate limiting, retry bounds, safe response receipts
bounded category/event/static-owner-page enumeration and stable-ID reconciliation

attachment/access classification for public_pdf/public_non_pdf/restricted/non-public/conflict states, true-export versus all-route reconciliation, safe no-redirect access-status receipts, secure PDF checkpointing, checksums, deterministic pdftotext extraction, and validated external OCR-body ingestion
dictionary-locked local matching, partition/tag invariants, overlap counts
content-free PDF, non-PDF, irregular/external, and OCR queue templates and receipt validation
automation_and_manual_boundary.manual_or_llm_scope: Only generated irregular, external, non-PDF, subcontribution, or OCR queues may use manual/LLM work. The operator may navigate an adapter-owned tab but must record stable input IDs, timestamp, output attachment/contribution IDs or hashes, terminal text/extraction outcome, and a failure reason. An unsupported, inaccessible, or unparseable material is not a no-match and leaves coverage null. No undocumented navigation can satisfy completeness.
automation_and_manual_boundary.storage_boundary: Raw exports and copyrighted PDFs/text belong in an operator-approved secure location outside Git. Git receives no raw PDF/source text and only safe hashes, counts, route paths, and receipts.

acceptance_blockers: Obtain supervisor acceptance or authoritative source evidence that category 0 is the all-public recursive universe; P03's bounded root/component union, inclusive-overlap observations, 148-row cap probe, and candidate sentinels do not prove this all-time claim.

Freeze a defensible all-time lower/upper sentinel and run the final source-wide category/event/material census twice after P-001; calibrate parent/child window unions because P03 observed no complete flag.
Find and validate a non-empty public subContributions owner/material route, or retain a final source-coverage failure whenever one appears. P03 found none in its bounded successful samples.

Validate terminal routing for every public non-PDF and a real irregular/external material in both final passes. P03 proved 28 public videos are queued and rejects an unsupported terminal receipt, but did not resolve them; no irregular/external export route was observed in its bounded successful scans.
Handle every event-local identity conflict as coverage null unless a new explicitly validated correction route resolves it; P03 observed event 321 attachment 6771 with conflicting title metadata.
Repeat full direct-download/checksum/parser/OCR reconciliation for every final public PDF in both final passes. P03 validates one current bounded 13-PDF path, not final all-source coverage.
